verdict.rationale: MPP is an open protocol co-authored by Stripe and Tempo, with its spec published at mpp.dev (including governance) and an mppx SDK on npm. The `mppx validate` conformance CLI end-to-end tests discovery, challenge formats, error handling, and the full payment flow. ACP is also published as an open Apache 2.0 specification that businesses can implement. Protocol versioning is only implied by the SDK version (0.9.3), and community feedback notes the MPP docs are sparse on end-to-end object semantics. Missing for 10: explicit spec versioning/changelog evidence, a machine-readable schema artifact (e.g. JSON Schema/OpenAPI) for ACP/MPP, conformance tooling for ACP, independent hands-on corroboration of the validator.
